t: You're looking at Corpus Christi, a Roman Catholic church on Maiden Lane in Covent Garden, along with its presbytery. The church is built in the Early English Gothic style and is grade II listed. It was designed by F. H. Pownall, and it was specifically devoted to the adoration of the Blessed Sacrament. Frederick Hyde Pownall was County Surveyor for Middlesex for about forty-five years, and he designed both Anglican and Roman Catholic churches, so this is one of several church designs from his career.
